ordinary_recovery_behavior: Password save must succeed before application entry.
Correct verification resumes through current remote identity, bearer, server proof and destination guards, then adopts the same account session and navigates to the application automatically.
Wrong/rejected code stays on verification with no normal-session adoption or protected navigation.
Missing or expired server proof, actor/bearer changes and destination failures prevent entry.
Adoption failures expose Retry sign-in without another password save or email code when the same current proof remains valid.
No extra account checkbox or Continue to app action for ordinary recovery.
preserved_behaviors: Unfinished Admin invitation setup or Free personal choice
Signup confirmation returns to manual sign-in
Separate Admin MFA dependency and guarded application proof
Isolated callback session cleanup without server logout of adopted session
requested_owner_action_now: Run pinned public ZIP preparation; return safe result. On exit 0 upload only the new ZIP to mushavo-budget-staging and provide its new deployment URL. No password save, email/code, SQL or secret change requested now.
current_open_tab: Already loaded older JavaScript. Keep it open; do not refresh or reuse its consumed link. If finishing this already verified old-build attempt, use its existing checkbox/Continue once. It cannot acquire the new behavior merely through deployment.
later_live_test: A fresh callback loaded from the updated staging build is required for scoped automatic-entry acceptance. Preserve existing readiness/identity/proof/window checks; no account recreation or profile repair.
